column1: # Gauntlet enforcement list (retro rulings O5, O6, O7, O19; 17-18 Oct 2026).
# A repo listed on a live line gets the new refusals: round 1 without a
# runner-recorded pre-review or a passing run-once, a new round after an approval that still stands, and a finding
# dropped or downgraded without a passing test. Every other repo gets the same checks as warnings only.
# One live line per repo, three tab-separated fields:
#   owner/repo <TAB> slot wrapper or - <TAB> run-once command (full tests, then a production-config boot)
# A run-once field `ci:<workflow file> [input=value ...]` runs the repo's own CI at the reviewed head instead
# (scripts/ci-run-once.sh: dispatch, then one GitHub read every 10 minutes), outside the slot; the wrapper
# A run-once field `none` means the repo has no run-once (no test workflow to run): round 1 still needs a
# recorded pre-review, and nothing is run. Size is a printed note only (12 Nov 2026).
# The wrapper prefixes the run-once command and every disposition test: cibox-slot.sh <name>, which runs it in a
# test VM. Never box-test-slot.sh, which runs type checks only and refuses tests (TRA-459).
# The run-once boot uses local or test services only: no tunnel, no production environment.
# A line starting with # is off. Going live is uncommenting a line with its agreed command.
